translations.web: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.
translations.bsb: They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
translations.kjv: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
